description:
What happened on the S&P 500 at the latest close: how many stocks rose and fell, how many sit 10%/20% below
    their 1-year high, and today's matches for fixed scans (5% drops with RSI under 30, breakouts on 2x volume,
    RSI above 80, 200-day dips in an uptrend, golden crosses, 5% drops), each with its record since 2017 vs random days
    and, where one exists, a link that opens that exact alert on trademanager.site.
name: what_happened_today
